name: D9b held-out support-versus-mapping audit
status: read-only diagnostic specification fixed before distance computation
purpose: distinguish missing input coverage, input-response ambiguity, and learned mapping error behind D9b held-out failures
scope: existing TRAIN fit/held-out groups and fixed D9b checkpoints only; no retraining, seed selection, thresholds, DEV, or TEST

distances.state: RMS Euclidean distance between 61D initial states after fit-only normalization
distances.action: RMS Euclidean distance over the model-visible first eight action steps using endpoint-symmetric pair mean and absolute difference at all six levels after fit-only normalization
distances.joint_input: root mean square of state distance and action distance, giving the two blocks equal weight
distances.nearest_response: minimum RMS distance between the held-out and fit physical 6-by-41 log-response curves
distances.nearest_input_response_mismatch: physical response-curve RMS distance to the fit group selected solely by joint input distance
distances.prediction_error: per-group curve RMS for each fixed seed and the cross-seed median

error_subsets.unanimous_false_boundary: reference boundary false and predicted boundary true for all three seeds
error_subsets.repeated_false_zero: nonzero physical amplitude but exact-zero predicted amplitude for at least two seeds

reporting: all per-group nearest neighbors and distances, subset percentile ranks, Spearman correlations, and seed prediction errors

diagnostic_markers.coverage_pressure: error-subset median joint-input percentile at least 0.75 or Spearman joint-input distance versus prediction error at least 0.4
diagnostic_markers.representation_ambiguity: error-subset median joint-input percentile below 0.75 while nearest-input response-mismatch percentile is at least 0.75
diagnostic_markers.mapping_error: error-subset median joint-input and nearest-input response-mismatch percentiles below 0.75 while prediction-error percentile is at least 0.75
